transactional_outbox_violation.defect_claim: An event is published with no surrounding transaction.
premises: The cited publish emits a state-change event whose loss would leave another service inconsistent.
No transaction or durable outbox enqueue covers the write the event describes.

outbox_entity_base_missing.defect_claim: A publisher does not use the @platform/outbox abstraction.
premises: The cited publisher emits a state-change event outside the @platform/outbox relay.
The file is not part of the outbox implementation itself.

quarantine.reason: outbox_scope_reads_only_the_outbox_machinery: both rules look for eventBus.publish, and the declared scope holds only outbox directories, so every hit is the outbox relay or the sanctioned best-effort wrapper (3 of 3 on main 88878799e are false positives) while raw publishes in domain code are never read
